title: Epping, Cape Town (Fisher Ave, approx.): 2 men shot dead in taxi attack, 16 Oct

story: SAPS says two men, aged 45 and 46, were shot dead on Fisher Avenue, Epping, on Friday 16 October at about 06:00, when men from a Toyota Quantum opened fire on their car. Police believe the motive is taxi-related. Two suspects, aged 27 and 31, were arrested on two counts of murder and were due in the Cape Town Magistrate's Court on 19 October (Cape Times). Accounts differ: a 17 October police statement called the dead men passengers and said the car's owner escaped (NovaNews); on 18 October police and Codeta called them taxi owners. Police gave the number of gunmen as about six, then seven.
location_note: Fisher Avenue, Epping 1, named by SAPS. The pin is on that street; the exact spot was not given.

provenance.statement_from: SAPS: a 17 Oct statement and an 18 Oct arrest statement
other_voices: Nceba Enge of Codeta (Cape Times only)
provenance.note: Mostly police statements, but not all. Cape Times and Cape Town ETC carry the same 18 Oct SAPS statement word for word, and NovaNews carries the earlier 17 Oct one. Only Cape Times adds a source outside the police: Codeta.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.detail: Earlier police account calls the dead passengers; later police account and Codeta call them taxi owners. See saved NovaNews paragraph 3 and Cape Times paragraphs 7 and 14.

sources.name: Brigadier Novela Potelwa, SAPS
sources.quote: Two men aged 45 and 46 were killed during the shooting.

facts.label: Date and time
facts.detail: 06:00 appears in NovaNews only; later reports confirm the day, not the hour.

sources.name: Brigadier Novela Potelwa, SAPS
sources.quote: travelling in a sedan along Fisher Avenue

facts.label: Method
facts.detail: NovaNews police quote: About six unidentified males; Cape Times police quote: Seven men.

sources.name: Brigadier Novela Potelwa, SAPS
sources.quote: Seven men from the taxi alighted and fired several shots at the other vehicle.

facts.label: Reported motive
facts.claim: Believed taxi-related; Codeta describes a preceding dispute.

sources.name: Lt-Col F.C. van Wyk, SAPS
sources.quote: The motive is believed to be taxi-related.

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Two suspects arrested, facing murder charges; expected in court 19 October.
facts.detail: Cape Town ETC embedded statement says 19/01, inconsistent with its own prose and Cape Times; retained as date typo, not resolved by asserting a hearing occurred.

sources.name: Brigadier Novela Potelwa, SAPS
sources.quote: the suspects were expected to appear in the Cape Town Magistrate’s Court on Monday, October 19.
